card.name: Final digit of a number before units
card.fires_on: The last digit of a multi-digit number in dose tables and storage temperatures, right before a unit such as mg or °C. Often the 8 in 2 to 8°C, or the 0 in 40 kg or 10 mg.

modes.description: Final digit of a dose amount or weight band just before mg or kg.

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a dose, weight or temperature number just before the unit.
